primary_source.title: Quantum weights of dyons and of instantons with non-trivial holonomy
primary_source.domain: Pure SU(2) Yang-Mills, periodic gauge/ghost fields on R^3 times a circle of circumference 1/T, neutral unit-topological-charge KvBLL saddle, common Pauli-Villars subtraction. For inverse separation expansion: D=d*T >> 1, a*D >> 1, b*D >> 1, 0<nu<1 fixed. No outer spatial wall.

deformation_source.title: Center-stabilized Yang-Mills theory: confinement and large N volume independence
deformation_source.scope: Defines the deformation and leading semiclassical monopole fugacity scaling; does not give an outer-radius derivative of the matched determinant or a curved-space vacuum stress.

notation.R: a physical outer radius only in our separately stated tail test

tail_test: Evaluate the local potential only on the declared unmodified BPS far tail q=v-1/r. This is not the determinant of a finite ball and not the full deformed saddle.
